name: Fukushima (Japan)
description: A red field charged at the centre with a white rosette of nine radiating loops.
history: The flag of Fukushima bears the city's mon (municipal emblem) in the Japanese civic tradition of a single stylised mark on a plain field.

features.role: Fukushima municipal emblem — a white rosette of nine radiating loops
features.symbolism: the kana フク (fuku) arranged in a circle
